title: Composed supervisory control: Alternating two-pump starts -> Three-pump staged dispatch with lead preference and feedback exclusion

outputs.name: A_NextPump
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Preferred pump for next demand: 1 or 2

outputs.name: A_Unavailable
outputs.description: Subsystem A: No available pump for demand

outputs.name: B_ActiveCount
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Number of commanded pumps

outputs.name: B_Failover
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Lead or requested capacity was replaced

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem A: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The runtime scan period is 100 ms.
Subsystem B: At most two pumps are required simultaneously.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: Each rising A_Demand shall start at most one available pump.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: When both pumps are available, successive A_Demand episodes shall alternate the selected pump.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: If the preferred pump is A_Unavailable, the other available pump shall run.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Unavailable shall be TRUE exactly when A_Demand is TRUE and neither pump is available.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset without A_Demand shall set A_NextPump to 1 and stop both pumps.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_LowDemand shall request one pump and B_HighDemand shall request two, with B_HighDemand taking priority.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Dispatch shall prefer B_Lead, then the next pump numbers cyclically, excluding unavailable or feedback-failed pumps.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: A commanded pump without feedback for 300 ms shall be excluded and replaced when capacity permits.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_ActiveCount shall equal the number of TRUE run outputs, and no more than two pumps may run.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_ActiveCount=count_true(B_Run1,B_Run2,B_Run3))) AND G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_ActiveCount<=2))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Failover shall be TRUE when an unhealthy preferred pump is bypassed or requested capacity cannot be met; insufficient capacity shall latch B_Fault.

While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Stop shall immediately clear every run command; B_Reset clears failures only while both demand inputs and B_Stop are FALSE.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_Stop -> (!B_Run1 AND !B_Run2 AND !B_Run3))) AND G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (qualified_reset -> !B_Fault))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_Pump1Run shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_Run1 AND NOT B_Run2 AND NOT B_Run3 AND B_ActiveCount=0 AND NOT B_Failover AND NOT B_Fault)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_Run1 AND NOT B_Run2 AND NOT B_Run3 AND B_ActiveCount=0 AND NOT B_Failover AND NOT B_Fault))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
